thread:
ola: hi! accepted the org invite but I can't find the 'Request to join team' button for eng-runtime — it's not showing on the team page. I can see some public teams but not eng-runtime. who do I ask to get added?
ben: welcome ola :wave: eng-runtime is a 'secret' team (we use that for infra-critical repos). secret teams don't show a request button. you'll need to be added by an org admin or team maintainer.
ola: ah that explains it. I thought the button was hidden for everyone. I do need push access to serving-runtime.
ben: okay — two paths: 1) you can open an access request in the onboarding doc (link in #new-hires pinned) and a maintainer will add you, or 2) i'll add you directly. can you confirm your GitHub username?
ola: it's ola-dev.
sam: pinging invite-bot to add ola-dev to eng-runtime and grant repo access. cc @invite-bot
invite-bot: Adding ola-dev to team eng-runtime and granting repo write on serving-runtime. Action queued at 2026-02-02T16:13:10Z
ben: done — you should get a membership notice. after you accept, try cloning with SSH or HTTPS. if you still see 404 or can't push, run `gh auth status` and paste output here.
ola: got the membership email and accepted. I can see eng-runtime now and clone worked. thanks!
ben: awesome — welcome to eng-runtime :tada: two quick tips: set your SSH key in Settings -> SSH and GPG keys, and use SSH remotes to avoid account/credential confusion.
ola: will do, thanks everyone :)
